items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: I went to, uh, Sam Morgan's band. ... I played with his band one year. Sam Morgan's.

ctx.x: So, well, after, after I left that band, then I started playing with my wife's uncle. His name was, uh, Onall the Pass. Oh, yes. You heard him? Drummer. Yeah, that's right. Never knew him, but I've heard of him. Well, he had, his band was called, he called his band Olympia Band. You see? I played with him just about four months. And one night I went over to a place called, I think they call it the E-Light at that time, it was a cabaret. They used to call them cabaret or cabaret, something like that. Is that one…
